class.name: DisStartResumePdu
class.brief_description: Start/Resume PDU (type 13): asks applications to start or resume the exercise.
class.description: A Start/Resume PDU asks the receiver to start or resume at the real-world time given by [member real_world_time_hour] and [member real_world_time_past_hour], and to set its simulation clock to the simulation time in [member simulation_time_hour] and [member simulation_time_past_hour]. It is 44 bytes long. The receiver answers with a [DisAcknowledgePdu] carrying the same [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id]. Each time is a DIS Clock Time record: a signed 32-bit hour count and a DIS timestamp past the hour (2^31 units per hour, shifted left by one; lowest bit set = absolute time). [method get_real_world_time] and [method get_simulation_time] (and their setters) convert them to and from seconds.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Start/Resume PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Start/Resume PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 44 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].

method.name: get_real_world_time
method.description: Returns the real-world start time in seconds since the UNIX epoch (UTC), computed from [member real_world_time_hour] and [member real_world_time_past_hour]. 0 means "now" for [DisExerciseControl].

method.name: get_simulation_time
method.description: Returns the simulation time in seconds, computed from [member simulation_time_hour] and [member simulation_time_past_hour].

method.name: set_real_world_time
method.description: Sets [member real_world_time_hour] and [member real_world_time_past_hour] from [param unix_seconds], seconds since the UNIX epoch (UTC), marking the time as absolute.

method.name: set_simulation_time
method.description: Sets [member simulation_time_hour] and [member simulation_time_past_hour] from [param seconds] of simulation time, marking the time as relative.

members.member: Hour part of the real-world time (signed 32-bit). Together with [member real_world_time_past_hour] this is the Clock Time record for the moment to start. See also [method set_real_world_time].
Time past the hour of the real-world time as a DIS timestamp (2^31 units per hour, shifted left by one; lowest bit set = absolute).
Hour part of the simulation time (signed 32-bit). See also [method set_simulation_time].
Time past the hour of the simulation time as a DIS timestamp (2^31 units per hour, shifted left by one; lowest bit set = absolute).
